name: Aisuru Kimi no Ibasho
original_name: アイするキミの居場所
source:
"I'm in love with you."
When the cherry blossoms were in full bloom, I gathered my courage and confessed to him.

My school life after that was so fufilling that anyone could tell.
Studying with my boyfriend after school, holding hands and going home together.
I would never let go, and always be by his side--that was how it was supposed to be.

Why did it turn out like this?

[Translated from the [url=https://cotocotton.wixsite.com/cotolia/blank-1]official website[/url]]
translation:
“我喜欢你。”
樱花盛开时，我鼓起勇气向他告白了。

从那以后，我的校园生活充实得任谁都看得出来。
放学后和男朋友一起学习，牵着手一起回家。
我不会松开他的手，会一直陪在他身边——本该如此。

为什么会变成这样？

[译自[url=https://cotocotton.wixsite.com/cotolia/blank-1]官方网站[/url]]
